{{Otheruses|Artom}}
'''Artom's Cluster''' was an award that was used by the [[Cularin Militia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was given to members of the Militia who carried out valiant and brave actions that went beyond the call of duty. Recipients of the award were looked upon with awe by other members of the Militia.
